So I think that was the biggest surprise to me and opened my eyes to how really broken it is because you can shut down debate pretty quickly on something that's important to you and your state if you can't get that committee chairman to even hold a hearing on it. Everything in DC moves on relationships. So you have to spend time. I figured out pretty quick that I got to make that chairman care enough about either my state, this bill that they're willing to dedicate precious time in front of their committee to it.
